title: לוחם ברברים
summary: המשקפיים של הסטרימר זוהרים בכחול והוא הופך ללוחם שרירי עם רונות כחולות ושריון עור ופרווה.

phases.what: Glasses glow electric blue, hair blows up
Transforms into muscular bearded man, shirt rips, glowing blue runes appear on torso
Shirt vanishes, leather armor with fur shoulders and bracers materializes with smoke and sparks
Warrior stands up and points a glowing blue hand at the camera

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and suddenly their eyes or glasses glow bright electric blue as wind blows their hair back. Keep the person recognizable initially as their clothes rip open, rapidly transforming them into a massive, muscular, bearded barbarian warrior with glowing blue rune markings pulsing across their chest and arms, surrounded by a blue aura. Smoke and orange sparks erupt around them as dark brown leather armor with metal medallions, leather bracers, and a thick fur shoulder mantle materialize over their body. Finally, the warrior stands up from the desk and points a hand crackling with blue lightning directly at the camera. Cinematic dramatic lighting with bright blue glow, vertical framing.
